affected_system: housing-stability, eviction prevention, shelter diversion, and support coordination
alternatives: rank verified high-consequence candidates for housing-stability prevention program portfolio
select a risk-, equity-, and lifecycle-balanced portfolio for housing-stability prevention program portfolio
pair outcome-, equity-, cost-, and capacity-aware program prioritization with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Court, assistance, shelter, outreach, housing, and service records use privacy-preserving linkage.
Risk models support outreach only and never determine legal rights or automatic denial.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: fund only already-committed work for housing-stability prevention program portfolio.

constraints.description: The homelessness prevention and housing stability prioritize must respect declared capital, operating, maintenance, and delivery budgets.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: homelessness response director and housing-stability administrator
decision_question: Which legal aid, rental support, mediation, navigation, and diversion measures should be expanded?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The homelessness prevention and housing stability prioritize must respect declared capital, operating, maintenance, and delivery budgets.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for housing-stability prevention program portfolio passes documented checks for cost, benefit, service life, dependencies, deliverability, and maintenance burden.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: outcome-, equity-, cost-, and capacity-aware program prioritization

intended_claim: A versioned prioritize design for comparing declared alternatives affecting housing-stability prevention program portfolio, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: distributional gap in expected unresolved housing-stability crises
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not report modeled crisis reduction as prevented eviction or homelessness.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for housing-stability prevention program portfolio passes documented checks for cost, benefit, service life, dependencies, deliverability, and maintenance burden.

title: Prioritize housing-stability prevention programs
transportability_risks: Eviction law, rents, benefits, shelter systems, informal displacement, and data linkage differ.
Administrative records omit people who do not seek or cannot access services.
